meta.notes: The tutorial's fourth mission: a walled post taken on the ground with the squad of four, by Shift with the command key (a part of the squad takes the new order) and the word. Two doors at once, a gun turned to the wrong door, two gates covered. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts tut-queue

steps.line: Walk to the marked corner of the guardroom, and your squad will follow you

explain.title: Two doors at once
explain.text:
The guardroom has two doors, and the guards inside can't watch both.
You'll put two teammates on each door, then send them all in at once.

steps.line: Press [B] on the guardroom door to stack your squad on it

after.line: They're stacking up on the door

steps.line: Hold [Shift] and press [B] on the side door to send two of them there

explain.title: Add a second order
explain.text:
When you press [B], your whole squad takes the order.
When you hold [Shift] and press [B], only part of your squad takes the new order. The rest keep doing what you told them before.

after.line: Two of them are going to the side door, and they'll wait there until you say go

steps.line: Press [F] to send both pairs in at once

after.word: Both pairs are going in together

steps.line: Press [B] on the hall's front door to stack your whole squad on it

after.line: They're stacking up on the front door

steps.line: Walk around to the marked spot behind the hall
Hold [Shift] and press [B] on the back door to send two teammates around to it

explain.title: A gunner watching the door
explain.text:
There's a gunner at the far end of the hall, and he's aiming at the front door, where your squad is stacked. If they all go in that way, they'll walk right into his fire.
The back door is right behind him.

after.line: Two of them are coming around to the back door

steps.line: Press [F] to send them in through both doors

after.word: The pair at the back door is coming in behind the gunner

steps.line: Press [B] on yourself to call your squad back to you

explain.title: Cover two gates
explain.text:
More enemies are on the way, and they'll come through the road gate and the back gate at the same time.
Hold [Shift] and press [B] on a spot, and your squad will turn to watch it from where they stand.

steps.line: Walk out to the marked spot in the yard, and they'll follow you
Hold [Shift] and press [B] on the marked spot by the road gate to have your squad watch it
Now hold [Shift] and keep [B] held down on the marked spot by the back gate
steps.flatLine: Press [2] to have two of them watch the back gate
steps.menuLine: Press [2] to have two of them watch the back gate

explain.title: Pick their order
explain.text:
If you keep [Shift] and [B] held down, the squad's wheel opens for part of your squad.
They'll take the order you pick, and the others will keep doing what they were doing.

steps.line: Hold both gates with your squad
